programme.title: Great Irish Interiors
programme.desc: Joined on to an earlier medieval riverside castle, Ormond Castle is the finest example of an Elizabethan manor house in Ireland. programme.title: Make Up: A Glamorous History

Once at war, the US will face not only German ships but the might of the Japanese empire.

programme.title: Wwii With Tom Hanks

programme.desc: Joined on to an earlier medieval riverside castle, Ormond Castle is the finest example of an Elizabethan manor house in Ireland. Built in 1565 by Thomas, 10th Earl of Ormond, in honour of his distant cousin Queen Elizabeth, the castle has since undergone significant conservation and preparation for a new era of visitation.

programme.title: Make Up: A Glamorous History
programme.desc: Makeup artist Lisa Eldridge takes us back to Britain in the 1920s, the time when modern makeup as we know it arrived in women's handbags. She explores how the look reflected the new freedoms of the era, and she recreates a classic 1920s look on our 21st century model using authentic products from the time.

programme.title: Junior Doctors Down Under
programme.desc: The pressure is on for Dr Javed who must insert an intravenous line for a 75-year-old patient with a partially torn aorta. Dr Natalie is tasked with sedating a patient who needs an electric jolt from a defibrillator to reset his abnormal heartbeat.

programme.title: Living Black Shorts
programme.desc: Living Black Shorts gives voice to some of the First Nations talent that have been interviewed by the Living Black team or worked at SBS over its remarkable 50 years on air.

programme.desc: The latest news from the oldest living culture, join Natalie Ahmat and the team of NITV journalists for stories from an Indigenous perspective.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw

programme.title: Lost For Words
programme.desc: The final two weeks of the program sees eight adult learners get reassessed and also attempt to achieve their personal goals. Makere reads a book to her kids and Lamine attempts his learner’s permit. The students work on building confidence for their graduation speeches by taking a Masterclass at NIDA run by famous Australian actor, writer and director Marcus Graham.

programme.title: Letters And Numbers
programme.desc: Two contestants pit their linguistic and numerical skills against each other and the clock in this entertaining quiz show. Join host Richard Morecroft along with maths whiz Lily Serna and wordsmith David Astle.

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Contenders from across Australia are challenged by quizmaster Marc Fennell in a bid to become Australia's next Mastermind Champion. In this final round for the week, the four reigning champions from this cycle battle it out to progress to the semi-finals.

programme.title: The Good Ship Murder
programme.desc: When rising starlet Mimi McQueen is murdered in Cannes, suspicion quickly falls on the odious director she had been working with. But Jack and Kate soon discover the truth lies with someone whose own ambitions were quietly derailed by Mimi. Amid the investigation, Jack and Kate find their own romance getting back on track, adding a personal thread to the case.

programme.title: Wwii With Tom Hanks
programme.desc: In 1940, German U-boats are sinking British hopes of victory. From the sidelines, FDR loans Britain much needed aid and manoeuvers US patrols to the edge of an 'undeclared war' with Germany. Meeting at a game-changing summit, Churchill and FDR align their goals. But as America and Britain get closer, so do the German U-boats. Once at war, the US will face not only German ships but the might of the Japanese empire.

programme.title: Wwii With Tom Hanks
programme.desc: America's "day of infamy" at Pearl Harbor is the birth of a new Japanese empire. Japan launches unprecedented attacks across Asia, proclaiming "Asia for the Asians" and pushing out Western colonial powers. Fuelled by ideology, Japan's armies are seemingly unstoppable - until a confrontation with the 1st Marine Division of the United States at Guadalcanal becomes a testing ground in a war without mercy.

programme.title: The King
programme.desc: Bruno tells Mancuso that they managed to trace the identity of his informer at SlimPetroil and that they found a magistrate willing to hear his testimony. Then, he reluctantly involves Gloria in the operation he has in mind. However, Verna is driven by a distorted vision of what he calls national interest and spares no one when it comes to protecting internal security. Bruno has no choice but to act accordingly, come what may.

programme.title: The Way

Tom, an irascible American doctor goes to France to deal with the tragic loss of his son. Rather than return home, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage 'The Way of St. James' to honour his son's desire to finish the journey. Stars Martin Sheen and Emilio Estevez.

programme.title: Hotel Salvation
programme.desc: Rajiv is forced to drop everything in order to accommodate his father's last and bizarre wish to travel to Varanasi to attain salvation.
